title: Meridian Cloud opens sovereign cloud region in Frankfurt
author: Sofia Brennan
text:
Meridian Cloud opens a new sovereign cloud region in Frankfurt, backed by a $2.6 billion investment over five years, to serve German public-sector agencies and regulated industries that require data to stay under European control.

The region is operated by a separately staffed German subsidiary, and customer data, encryption keys and support personnel remain inside the European Union, the company said. It is Meridian's first sovereign region and its third region in Germany.

"European customers asked for cloud services where control, not just location, stays local," said Annika Vogt, managing director of Meridian Cloud Germany. "This region is built around that requirement."

The move comes as Meridian faces a European Commission inquiry into its data egress fees, opened earlier this month. Analysts said the sovereign region could help the company show European officials that it is responsive to local concerns, although the two matters are formally unrelated.

Meridian said two federal agencies and a large insurer had signed up as its first customers. The company plans to add sovereign regions in France and Italy in 2027.
